global.description: Global values to be accessed by all (sub)charts.

nameOverride.description: Overrides chart name used for app.kubernetes.io/name.

mongodb-kubernetes.description: Values passed through to the upstream mongodb-kubernetes subchart (MongoDB Community Operator). See https://github.com/mongodb/helm-charts for the full list.

instanceReport.description: Optional kube-state-metrics deployment reporting inventory and status.phase for MongoDBCommunity custom resources cluster-wide.

enabled.description: Whether to deploy the MongoDB instance report.

replicas.description: Number of instance report pod replicas.

repository.description: FQDN of the kube-state-metrics image repository.

telemetry.description: Port serving kube-state-metrics' own self-monitoring telemetry.

scrapeInterval.description: ServiceMonitor scrape interval for the metrics endpoint (e.g. 30s).

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the kube-state-metrics container.
